description: This file defines classes and functions for project template management, including project initialization, template registration, and file copying with variable replacements. It includes classes for different project templates, a factory for creating templates, and an initializer to orchestrate project setup. It also contains a main function demonstrating project configuration and initialization.

classes.name: ProcessingStep
classes.description: Enum for processing steps (Pre-processing and Post-processing).

classes.name: TemplateProvider
classes.description: Manages template locations and access, providing template paths based on project type.

classes.name: ProjectTemplate
classes.description: Abstract base class for project templates, defining interface and common methods for project setup.

classes.name: ProjectTemplateFactory
classes.description: Factory class for registering and creating project template instances based on project type.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Main orchestrator class for initializing projects, managing template creation, and waiting for post-processing.

classes.name: FileSystemHelper
classes.description: Helper class providing static methods for copying files and directories with variable replacements.

methods.name: get_init_info
methods.description: Returns template initialization information, including build commands, environment config, and scripts.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Performs project initialization steps: validation, pre-processing, structure generation, testing setup, and post-processing.

methods.name: wait_for_post_process_completed
methods.description: Waits for post-processing to complete within a specified timeout, checking status files.

methods.name: _run_processing_script
methods.description: Runs a processing script either synchronously or in the background, managing status files and logs.
